Program
Biology

Students who complete the program are prepared to transfer to a baccalaureate program in biology at an accredited college or university. It is appropriate for students interested in pre-professional study such as ecology, pharmacy, veterinary science and education, and it may also apply to technician-level work where two years of academic preparation in biology are required. Electives should be chosen with the requirements of the transfer institution in mind.

Upon completion of this program students will be able to:
  • Correctly explain and apply the scientific method, and competently analyze data;
  • Demonstrate safe laboratory practices and correct use of laboratory equipment;
  • Assess ethical scenarios in the life sciences and propose possible outcomes.
